items.title: Shareholders continue to pull back on environmental resolutions
items.summary: The number of shareholder resolutions focused on environmental issues continues to decline, according to a review of proposals filed during the first half of 2026.

items.title: The campaign that kick-started the net-zero movement is shifting focus
items.summary: Race to Zero, an influential campaign that catalyzed support for net zero from thousand of large companies, is winding down as its leaders shift focus to delivery of climate commitments.

items.title: From Scope 3 to packaging reforms: edie’s next virtual collaborations open to Members
items.summary: From September to December, edie is hosting bi-weekly virtual discussions on a host of key topics to help sustainability professionals upskill departments, learn from other sectors and promote sustainable actions.

items.title: Fossil fuel gains outweigh AI’s climate benefits, study finds
items.summary: According to new analysis, fossil fuel productivity gains enabled by artificial intelligence (AI) will outweigh any emissions reductions the technology generates across renewable energy applications – a huge carbon reporting blind spot.

items.title: Homes near pylon projects to receive discounted energy bills under Government scheme
items.summary: The Government is offering cheaper energy bills for communities that host grid infrastructure, with savings of up to £2,500 expected over the next 10 years.

items.title: Slow connections threaten UK industrial electrification, report warns
items.summary: According to a new report from ADE: Demand, factories are giving up on connecting to the UK grid in favour of gas as a result of slow connection timelines.

items.title: The drought aftershock: What water stress means for Europe’s businesses long term
items.summary: With temperatures set to exceed 30C across Europe and the UK again this week, drought conditions are intensifying across the continent.

items.title: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation enters into force: Everything you need to know
items.summary: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) becomes legally binding for businesses today (12 August).
